question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Affects** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Affects **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • The verb "**affect**" means to produce a change or influence something. (कोई परिवर्तन उत्पन्न करना या किसी चीज़ को प्रभावित करना) • **Example**: *The new government policy greatly affects the economy.* • In this context, "affects" refers to the impact or influence of something. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Compromises **means to reach a settlement or agreement by making concessions. (रियायतें देकर किसी समझौते या समझौते पर पहुँचना) • **Effects **means the result or consequence of an action. (किसी कार्य का परिणाम या परिणाम) • **Controls **means to manage or regulate something. (किसी चीज़ का प्रबंधन या विनियमन करना) 48:T8cf, The correct answer is: **Enough**
